title: The unit directions of H that are not axis directions of A form a Borel set (σ-compactness of the axis set, Step 2)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, E := Rn N = ℝ^N, H ⊆ E a linear subspace with orthogonal projection p_H := H.starProjection, A ⊆ E compact, δ ∈ ℝ and a ∈ E. Then the following is a Borel (measurable) subset of E: the set of θ ∈ E such that θ ∈ H, |θ| = 1, and there is no b ∈ A with b ≠ a, dist(b, a) < δ and p_H(b − a) − (p_H(b − a)·θ)θ = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (H : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (A : Set (Rn N)), IsCompact A → ∀ (δ : ℝ) (a : Rn N), MeasurableSet {θ : Rn N | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1 ∧ ¬ ∃ b ∈ A, b ≠ a ∧ dist b a < δ ∧ H.starProjection (b - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (b - a)) θ • θ = 0}
